annotations.title: Stock passport: one company, every token

description: The stock passport: one company (ISIN) with every token of it, before you buy, lend against or accept one as collateral. Per issuer: the entity, jurisdiction, what the holder legally holds, how reserves are evidenced, and redemption terms from the issuer’s own documents (who may redeem, KYC, minimum, fee, settlement, what is delivered, who is excluded; source URL and date). Per token: the supply waterfall (gross minted, the issuer’s own wallets, bridge custody, outside holders; a value only where the issuer’s wallets were read at the same block as the supply), the price gap to the share now and over seven days, exit cost for $1k/$10k/$100k (a model), pause/freeze/permanent-delegate and OFAC screening of the control keys, top 10 holders. Plus corporate actions of the last 90 days (Finnhub, confirmed by the issuer’s multiplier), vaults and markets that take it as collateral, and agent activity over 24 hours. EVERY BLOCK CARRIES `state`: read, issuer_says, model or not_read (with `reason`); a value not read is null, never zero, so quote the state with the figure. FREE. The full history is stock_passport_history (paid). Not investment advice.

isin.description: An ISIN (US88160R1014); a token symbol (TSLAx) or a share ticker (TSLA) is also accepted.
